# copick match

*Match references against copick tomograms.*

## Usage

```bash
copick match [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

## Description

Commands in this group locate particles in copick tomograms by matching a
reference, such as a template, against them and write the resulting picks
back to copick. Subcommands are contributed by installed plugins.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [`pytom`](pytom.md) | Find particles by template matching with pytom-match-pick. |
| [`pytom-extract`](pytom-extract.md) | Extract particles again from score maps stored by 'copick match pytom --maps'. |
